scope: All tracked repositories receive automated commit-message and open-PR title/body screening. The decisions below are focused human-readable adaptation reviews; they do not certify all upstream patches.

reviews.reason: Console layouts 189/191 (4 bytes) and 190 (1 byte), with the synthetic layout test, exist in the inherited base.
Source diff reviewed. Removed unreachable f16 arms and no-op scaffolding in lower.rs. Kept int_value because this snapshot still calls it. Integer-dot and half-input changes do not match this base.
reviews.validation: victory-shader: 177 passed, 2 ignored before and after; workspace tests pass on Linux. No title run or GPU performance claim.

reviews.reason: PR description reviewed: broad core replacement plus DXC fallback restoration. Requires separate review of memory semantics, shader changes and Windows host compilation; cannot be treated as one safe Linux cherry-pick.

PR description reviewed: persistent page-view cache and pre-write notification. Potential Wine map/unmap savings, but current implementation uses Windows mapping and write-watch semantics; needs a tested host-memory boundary before adaptation.
PR title identifies a builder crash and says the ray-tracing builder remains disabled. Preserve default-off RT; title evidence has not been reproduced here.

PR description reviewed: independent HLSL f16 translator, stacked interpreter work, and AMD signed-zero workaround. Compare synthetic signed-zero and round-to-nearest behavior against existing Rust f16 tests before adapting any algorithm.

PR description reviewed: in-place instruction rewriting under VirtualProtect/VEH. Requires Linux exception handling, executable-page synchronization and instruction-cache tests; no direct Windows patch import.
PR description reviewed: depth-bounds workaround verified on WARP, physical Radeon testing pending. Require VKD3D-Proton/RADV pixel-readback evidence before enabling a corresponding workaround.

Ported DPP fi/bound_ctrl, inactive swizzle sources, pixel helper first-lane reads, and zero-stride buffer access. Adapted activity checks to the local EXEC guard and mesh quad mapping. Pixel Valid-Mask/export rewrite remains deferred for separate control-flow validation. Synthetic regressions failed before their fixes and pass afterwards; no GPU execution claim.

Raw-VCC branch semantics made explicit. Original upstream regression already passed because this IR omits EXEC branch reads; strengthened test adds an EXEC dependency and reproduces the erroneous mask.

Four staging hash sites use a portable helper: serial below 1 MiB, parallel BLAKE3 at/above. Equivalence tested at chunk/tree/threshold boundaries. Rayon dependencies locked. Windows staging and runtime performance not exercised.
This base already skips equal eight-byte spans in shadow::changed_runs. The PR scans a later mask-based implementation; no duplicate optimization added.
src64_dwords and high-dword-first signed/unsigned comparisons already exist.
Texture detile already specializes equal 8/16/32-byte runs with copy_runs.
Sample both constant bindings and select the texel using the original uniform branch edge. Preserve derivatives and retain unreachable-edge handling.
reviews.validation: Synthetic regression failed before the port; victory-shader passes 184 tests with 2 ignored on Linux. GPU execution unverified.

reviews.reason: Trace both scalar-copy chains back to the same known mask in their original dword order. Reject a duplicated or replaced high dword.
reviews.validation: Synthetic intact/corrupted-mask regression failed before the port. The portable shader suite passes on Linux; GPU execution unverified.

reviews.reason: Keep v_nop, v_pipeflush and v_clrexcp one dword even when unused fields resemble literal, SDWA or DPP extension markers.
reviews.validation: Regression failed before the port. Test all three opcodes against five extension markers, including a final instruction without a following word.

reviews.reason: Decode v_cmpx destinations as EXEC rather than encoded VDST. Preserve ordinary compare destinations.
reviews.validation: Regression failed before the port. Test both wave sizes and five encoded destinations; all 187 portable shader tests pass.
